author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಾತೊರೆದು ಕಲಿವುದಕೆ ಕೋಶಗಳನೋದುತಿರು
ಕೂತಿರದೆ ಸುತ್ತುತಲೆ ಜಗವನೀನರಿಯೊ
ಮಾತುಗಳು ಸವಿಯಾಗಿ ಮನಗಳನು ಮುಟ್ಟಲಿಹ
ಕಾತುರತೆ ನಿನಗಿರಲಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Keep reading books, eager to learn;
don’t just sit; travel and come to know the world;
and may you have a longing for words
that sweetly touch the hearts of others, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Read widely, see the world, and learn to speak in a way that touches people. A hunger for learning makes a rich life.
